reason: My bookkeeper already runs everything through Zoho and it works well enough. The missing documents are a staff discipline problem, and I'm not adding another tool and another login from overseas on the strength of a Telegram bot I've never heard of.
objection: It's another layer on top of an app we already pay for. A Google Sheet doesn't replace Zoho for my accountant, and I don't know who is behind this bot or what happens to my financial documents if it goes away.
would_change_my_mind: My bookkeeper telling me it pushes straight into Zoho or Jurnal and actually cuts the month-end chasing, ideally proven on the free 40 documents from our real chat history.
